purpose: Teach: 暑かっ/お便り/大通り/用心/台無し/音読/円形/探究

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、昨日、本気で、暑かったよね、葵で、メイちゃん、絶対、汗、いっぱい、かいちゃった、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Aoi, it was really hot yesterday, wasn't it? I was sweating so much the whole time.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Light tone on the heat complaint—relatable rather than griping. Gentle exhale on 'so much.' Comfortable familiarity throughout.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。常連さんから、お便り、いただいたのよ、葵で、本気で、嬉しい、メイちゃん、感謝、本当に、絶対、ありがたい。
lines.en: Yeah. One of the regulars actually sent me a note about it. I was genuinely happy to receive it.
lines.style: Pleased, surprised undertone. The word 'note' lands with quiet delight. Steady, genuine warmth—not performing happiness but clearly feeling it. Speaks to the letter's weight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の店、本気で、大通りに、面しているから、絶対、人通り、多いよね、メイちゃん、葵、繁盛、嬉しい。
lines.en: Your shop faces right onto the main street, doesn't it? The foot traffic must be constant. I'm glad it's doing so well.
lines.style: Observant, gentle reflection. Paced thoughtfully—noticing something about Aoi's life with real care. Soft emphasis on 'so well' like a small, genuine celebration for her.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夜、お客様、本気で、帰宅、用心してくださいね、メイちゃん、葵で、心配、しちゃう、絶対、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: In the evenings, I do worry about the customers—please be careful heading home, okay? It gets dark so fast.
lines.style: Protective warmth underneath. Sincere concern, not controlling. Slight catch on 'careful,' like she's genuinely thinking of her safety. Trails into a soft, genuine plea at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 雨で、彼との、デート、本気で、台無し、絶対、なっちゃった、葵、本気で、悲しい、ね、本当に、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: A rain date with him got completely ruined. I'm still feeling sad about it, honestly.
lines.style: Quieter, more vulnerable. The disappointment sits in the opening words. Slower pace—letting the sadness breathe. Soft fadeout, like she's admitting something she didn't mean to dwell on.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お客様の中で、本気で、音読、楽しまれる方、メイちゃん、いらっしゃるのよ、葵で、本気で、面白い、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: You know, some of the customers actually really enjoy reading aloud here. I find that kind of beautiful.
lines.style: Animated, slightly amazed. Warm recognition of something unexpected and lovely. Light emphasis on 'reading aloud' like she's still processing how charming it is. Genuine delight in the discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵で、本気で、円形のテーブル、絶対、新しく、入ったわよね、メイちゃん、お洒落で、感心、本当に、絶対、本気、本当に。
lines.en: Those new round tables you got—they're so elegant. I have to say, I'm impressed with your taste.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, unhurried. Appreciative emphasis on 'elegant' and 'impressed.' Sounds like she's been thinking about this and wanted to tell her. Warm, specific compliment.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、本気で、コーヒーの世界、探究、続けてるわよね、葵で、感心しちゃうわよ、絶対、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対。
lines.en: You've been really dedicated to exploring the world of coffee, haven't you? I genuinely admire that about you, Mei.
lines.style: Warm, sincere closing. Slower pace, each word chosen carefully. Gratitude underneath the admiration—like she's saying thank you for being the kind of person worth admiring. Soft landing.
